title: Balanced Subarrays
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 4 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq T \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq N \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq K \leq \min(N,10); 1 \leq A_i \leq N; 1 \leq B_k \leq N; B_1,B_2,\dots,B_K are pairwise distinct.; The sum of N over all test cases is at most 2 \times 10^5.; All input values are integers.
